"""One finite Git-only tail reconciliation; never repeat an image request."""
import json,os,subprocess,sys,traceback
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
folder=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-20261025';old_path=folder/'publisher-resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v7.json';old=read_json(old_path)
assert old['status']=='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay'
deadline=old['original_deadline_utc'];assert datetime.now(timezone.utc)<datetime.fromisoformat(deadline)
recovered=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/checkpoint-resumed-low-v7-auto-2-rebased-20261025.json');assert recovered['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified'
git_proof=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/low-v8-review-recovery-evidence-pushed-20261025.json')
run='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v7';state=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json');assert state['status']=='stopped_at_safe_boundary' and state['completed_source_requests']==36
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/master-git-readback.lock').exists()
progress=folder/'v7-tail-reconciliation-20261025.json';assert not progress.exists()
lock=folder/'publisher.lock';fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY);os.write(fd,str(os.getpid()).encode('ascii'));os.close(fd)
before_path=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261025-v7-publisher-original-failed-state.json';assert not before_path.exists()
write_json(before_path,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'preserved_at_utc':utc_now(),'original_failed_state':old,'original_failed_state_sha256':file_sha256(old_path),'scope':'Original finite Git publisher failure retained before tail reconciliation. Original image deadline/counters/errors remain unchanged; no image replay.'})
batch='resumed-low-v7-recovery-tail-20261025'
record={'machine_id':machine_id(),'pid':os.getpid(),'started_at_utc':utc_now(),'original_deadline_utc':deadline,'original_failed_state':before_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'batch':batch,'status':'snapshotting_remaining_LOW','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'scope':'One finite Git-only tail checkpoint after actual original15 readback. Snapshot may include contemporaneous v8 outputs; actual counts are recorded, never counted as v7-only. No generation, art approval, canonical mutation or PNG replay.'}
def persist(**kw):record.update(kw,observed_at_utc=utc_now());write_json(progress,record)
def checked(args,timeout=1800):
 r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=timeout)
 assert r.returncode==0,(args,r.stdout,r.stderr)
 return r.stdout
try:
 assert checked(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).strip()==git_proof['commit']
 assert not checked(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only']).strip()
 persist()
 checked([sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoint-20261025.py'),batch,'--incremental'])
 receipt=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints/{batch}/receipt.json');out=ROOT/f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json';assert not out.exists()
 write_json(out,{**receipt,'original_publisher_reconciliation':progress.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'isolated_git_synchronization':{'status':'pending_in_separate_network_publisher','primary_worktree_untouched':True}})
 persist(status='publishing_and_verifying_tail',commit=receipt['commit'],new_original_PNGs=receipt['new_original_PNGs'],new_original_bytes=receipt['new_original_bytes'])
 checked([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'tools/production_checkpoint_publish.py'),receipt['commit'],batch])
 publication=read_json(out);assert publication['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified'
 readback=read_json(ROOT/publication['remote_original_readback']);assert readback['status']=='verified' and readback['commit']==receipt['commit']
 index=json.loads(checked(['git','show',receipt['commit']+':mod_nailong/data/fullsize-files.json']))
 all_success=[];errors=0;window_count=0
 for path in sorted((ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-window-timings').glob(run+'-window*-completed.json')):
  w=read_json(path);assert w['machine_id']==machine_id() and w['status']=='completed';window_count+=1
  events=[e for e in w['events'] if e['phase']=='image_resolved'];assert len(events)==1
  event=events[0]
  if event.get('error'):errors+=1;continue
  commands=[e['command'] for e in w['events'] if e['phase']=='local_command_started' and 'production_queue.py returned --key '+event['key']+' --image ' in e['command']]
  assert len(commands)==1
  cache=Path(commands[0].split(' --image ',1)[1]);digest=file_sha256(cache)
  assert digest in index['outputs'];entry=index['outputs'][digest]
  assert entry['bytes']==cache.stat().st_size and entry['path']==f'mod_nailong/assets/generated_fullsize/{digest}.png'
  all_success.append({'window':w['window_id'],'key':event['key'],'returned_at_utc':event['observed_at_utc'],'unchanged_cache_sha256':digest,'published_raw_path':entry['path']})
 assert window_count==36 and len(all_success)==35 and errors==1
 assert read_json(old_path)==old,'Another writer changed old publisher state'
 tail_audit=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261025-low-v7-tail-reconciled.json';assert not tail_audit.exists()
 write_json(tail_audit,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'completed_at_utc':utc_now(),'original_publisher_failed_state':before_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'original_deadline_utc':deadline,'actual_recovered15_publication':recovered,'actual_tail_publication':publication,'actual_tail_fixed_commit_readback':readback,'all35_v7_successful_calls_covered_by_verified_fixed_index':all_success,'v7_calls':36,'v7_PNG_returns':35,'v7_refusals':1,'scope':record['scope'],'source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
 final=dict(old);final.update(status='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline',finished_at_utc=utc_now(),reconciled_at_utc=utc_now(),last_checkpoint_requests=36,last_completed_requests=36,last_commit=receipt['commit'],reconciliation=tail_audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),original_error_preserved=True)
 final.setdefault('reconciled_checkpoints',[]).extend([{'batch':recovered['batch'],'commit':recovered['commit'],'recovery_of':recovered['original_failed_commit'],'new_original_PNGs':15},{'batch':batch,'commit':receipt['commit'],'new_original_PNGs':receipt['new_original_PNGs'],'scope':'Includes actual cross-phase LOW tail snapshot, not claimed all v7-only.'}])
 write_json(old_path,final)
 persist(status='finished_and_old_publisher_reconciled',completed_at_utc=utc_now(),v7_successful_outputs_verified=35,reconciliation=tail_audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ['source_code','scope']},ensure_ascii=True))
except BaseException:
 persist(status='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay',error=traceback.format_exc());raise
finally:
 assert lock.read_text()==str(os.getpid());lock.unlink()
